object.name: session_inhibit_manager
object.description: Creates lifetime-bound inhibitors for system operations, idle handling, and low-level handling of power keys and the lid switch.

arg.name: what
arg.summary: bitmask of what values to inhibit

arg.name: who
arg.summary: application or component requesting the inhibitor

description.summary: the inhibitor could not be created

value.name: shutdown
value.summary: powering off or rebooting the system

value.name: handle_power_key
value.summary: low-level handling of the power key

value.name: handle_suspend_key
value.summary: low-level handling of the suspend key

value.name: handle_hibernate_key
value.summary: low-level handling of the hibernate key

value.name: handle_lid_switch
value.summary: low-level handling of the lid switch

value.name: handle_reboot_key
value.summary: low-level handling of the reboot key

value.name: block_weak
value.summary: block unprivileged operations requested by other users

value.name: invalid_what
value.summary: what is zero or contains unknown bits

value.name: unsupported
value.summary: one or more requested inhibitor types are unsupported
